precepts.text: When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, then shall they dwell in the land I gave to my servant Jacob. So what is Netanyahu talking about? The gathering is God's, from among the nations, and it is also the answer when someone brings up Revelation 7:9 on the street.
precepts.point: He shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet and gather his elect from the four winds. Israel is his elect.
precepts.why:
Christ said the angels “shall gather together his elect from the four winds”. Ezekiel shows who does the gathering and from where: “Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”.

When who? The Lord God. The house of Israel is gathered from among the people where they are scattered: from the nations, from the four winds. So what is Netanyahu talking about? What are the not-so-Israelis over there talking about? The gathering is God's, and it is out of the nations, not a state set up by men.

“And shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” Only when God has gathered them do they dwell in the land he gave to Jacob.

That is also the answer when someone on the street brings up Revelation 7:9 and the great multitude out of all nations: it is the house of Israel, gathered from among the people where they were scattered, the elect of Isaiah 45, “Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”.

precepts.text: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee. Daniel interpreted dreams; America interprets your next move with its surveillance. That is why the school strike was no mistake.
precepts.point: A ranking man among us re-enlisted in the army in the middle of Bible prophecy, knowing he will be deployed. Everyone in purple and gold is not in the right mindset, and Passover is around the corner: the purging begins, people drop, because the leaven has to be removed.
precepts.why:
The beast has “upon his heads the name of blasphemy”, and “he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven”: the Most High, Christ and the angels. That is what they do: they lie against God’s people and God himself. “The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.”

Look at the Tomahawk missile that hit the elementary school in Minab, Iran, killing 175 people, mostly children. First they blamed Iran; then they said it was a mistake from outdated targeting data; then Trump said, I don’t know about it. Don’t listen for one second to these liars.

Ezekiel 28:3 answers them: “Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee”. What was Daniel able to do? Interpret dreams. America is able to interpret your next move, because they have that kind of surveillance and technological capability. The Bible prophesied it.

So if there is no secret that can be hid from America, according to God, how did they mistakenly hit a school and think it was part of a base? It was no mistake. It shows you they are crooks and liars, the beast with a mouth speaking blasphemies. And to our people still asleep and following behind the beast, even a ranking man among us who re-enlisted in the army in the middle of Bible prophecy, knowing he will be deployed: come up out of this foolishness.

precepts.text: I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations, terrorists, and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom and defile thy brightness. Wisdom is double, Job 11:6: contextually the king of Tyrus, prophetically America, which everyone thought untouchable. It decays from the inside out, then the finale with the ten horns, and its pretence of moral world police is defiled.
precepts.point: Stumble not at the beauty of a woman, and desire her not for pleasure. Many of you see America as a gorgeous woman and are mesmerized; every pleasure is available in her. Many brothers fall by harlots, and you do not have to pick up a prostitute to be dealing with the mother of all harlots.
precepts.why:
“Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations.” Contextually this is spoken to the king of Tyrus, who was said to be wiser than Daniel. But when you read the scriptures, a passage may speak contextually of one nation and prophetically of another, because the Lord shows “the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is!” Prophetically, this is Babylon the Great, America.

Who are the strangers, the terrible of the nations? The Allahu Akbar type strangers. Another word for it would be terrorists. “And they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom.” A lot of people thought America could never be touched. The Lord is showing you otherwise. When she begins to fall, she will be destroyed from the inside out, decaying, and then comes the great finale with the ten horns.

“And they shall defile thy brightness.” America likes to put on as if she is righteous, playing the moral world police, while she goes into countries, steals presidents and bombs everybody. That brightness will be defiled.

So don’t stumble at her beauty. The beauty of her wisdom and her brightness are exactly what the Lord has marked for the sword.

precepts.text: The black horse is the dark nations Esau rules, and the white man on it holds a pair of balances. A measure of wheat for a penny: America's World Bank and IMF dictate the price of wheat worldwide and declare Jamaica's, Sierra Leone's, and Haiti's money no good, though those countries have the resources. Might makes right. See thou hurt not the oil and the wine, do not deal unjustly.
precepts.point: Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God, I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations, the terrorist nations, and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom; thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas. Their military gets wiped out at sea, and it will take time.
precepts.why:
Ezekiel says the prince of Tyrus got his riches “By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick”. Traffic means trade. Revelation 6 shows the same man and how he runs the trade of the world: “And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see.” This third beast, this powerful angel, says to John, I am going to show you something.

“And I beheld, and lo a black horse”. The black horse represents the dark nations that Esau is over. This whole chapter deals with Esau's rulership, from the white horse to the red horse, and now the black horse. “and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand”: the white man sitting on the black horse, holding a pair of balances, a scale of right and wrong weight and measure.

“A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny”. Who dictates how much wheat should cost worldwide? It is America: their World Bank, their IMF. They control the economy of the world. They are the ones that say Jamaica's money is no good, Sierra Leone's money is no good, Haiti's money is garbage. Yet those countries have all the resources, and America doesn't. But might makes right: America has the military arsenal, so all nations have to shut the hell up. “and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine”: see thou, meaning do not deal unjustly.

So verses 5 and 6 are the IMF and the World Bank, the world economy. That is the “great wisdom” and “traffick” of Ezekiel 28 by which the prince increased his riches and lifted up his heart. And don't let America tell you it is broke: its debt is in its own money, and it prints its own money. How can you owe yourself?

In order to get the fame and fortune that many of our people so desperately want, because we want to take care of our friends and family, you have to sell your soul. You must give your soul to these people.

That is often called hush money. Someone as wealthy as LeBron James takes care of his friends, which is admirable, and his family, which is admirable. But in terms of helping his people on a major level, he is not allowed to do that. That is hush money: hush the F up, and just take care of your friends and family. Oprah, all these people; many of them have gone to Epstein's Island, and their names are on the list.

So the riches of the man who says “I am a God” are not a blessing to reach for. Whoever gains his world gets it by trading away his soul, and the Lord has already said he will bring the terrible of the nations upon that man and bring him down to the pit.

Ezekiel goes on: “With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches”. They figured out how to manipulate all these laws to get what they want: Trump is going to get that oil and that land in Venezuela. And the vessels of brass are all the other things, the oils, the jewels and the precious metals. Revelation 18 lists the same: all the gold and precious things, and then the souls of men.

So the riches that lifted up the prince's heart were built by trading our people, and the same system still drains Africa and Latin America alike. It is only a failure if you are on the side being oppressed; for that man of sin, Babylon the Great, it is an absolute success. That is why the nations will lament when judgment comes on Babylon: they got rich off the systems America put in place.
